_note: Recommendation (AI-generated): hand-written by Grok Bot from the quotes in each cluster of data/insights.json (10 Oct 2026). Treat as hypotheses to validate with product/engineering; they are not user statements.

pay_failed.user_need: Pay or recharge with a saved Visa / credit / debit card without errors
pay_failed.product_change: Audit the card-payment flow end to end (gateway errors, saved-card tokens, 'no tengo internet' false errors); show a clear failure reason and a one-tap retry or switch-method; add payment-failure monitoring per method

bug_errors.user_need: An app that opens and completes tasks without generic 'Error' / 'Algo salió mal' messages
bug_errors.product_change: Replace generic errors with specific, actionable messages; instrument crash/error analytics by screen and app version; prioritise errors on payment and promo screens, where most of these reports sit

bug_login.user_need: Register and sign in reliably; verification code arrives
bug_login.product_change: Fix registration edge cases ('ya está registrado' when it isn't); deliver OTP by SMS without needing mobile data, with resend and voice-call fallback; keep users signed in and stop mid-flow logouts

conn_data_required.user_need: Open the app and recharge or buy a package when out of data or on Wi-Fi
conn_data_required.product_change: Zero-rate the app (and OTP) on the Más Móvil network so it works with no data balance; make sure every flow works on Wi-Fi; offer a USSD/SMS fallback for recharge and package purchase

pay_extra_day.user_need: Get the advertised 'día extra / +1 día' bonus when recharging
pay_extra_day.product_change: Fix the '+1 día' promo option that shows 'en mantenimiento'; apply the bonus automatically after a qualifying recharge and show a confirmation with its expiry; state the eligible payment methods up front

bug_security_block.user_need: Use the app installed from Google Play without 'modified app' / USB-debugging blocks
bug_security_block.product_change: Re-tune the integrity/root check: allow Play-installed builds and Developer Options/USB debugging, block only real tampering, and explain the reason with a help link instead of a hard block

pay_methods.user_need: Choose any payment method (card, debit, scratch-card balance), not only Yappy
pay_methods.product_change: Offer the same promos across all payment methods, or show clearly which method each promo needs; let users add and save multiple cards; fix 'método de pago en mantenimiento'

acct_rewards.user_need: Rewards (premios, giros, cupones) that are easy to understand and actually arrive
acct_rewards.product_change: Simplify how rewards are claimed; show reward status and expiry in one place; deliver data/WhatsApp prizes automatically; review the short expiry of free plays

pay_balance_not_accepted.user_need: Use phone balance from a scratch card to buy promos and data packages
pay_balance_not_accepted.product_change: Allow phone balance as a payment method for in-app promos and packages, or clearly flag ineligible promos before checkout

acct_plans.user_need: Find, buy and change plans or packages in the app
acct_plans.product_change: Make the package catalogue always visible (even with no data); add 'change my plan'; confirm activation immediately after purchase

bug_crash.user_need: App opens and doesn't freeze during payment
bug_crash.product_change: Investigate freezes on the saved-card payment step; add crash reporting per version

pay_charged_not_applied.user_need: When charged, the package or plan is activated (or refunded) automatically
pay_charged_not_applied.product_change: Make charge and activation atomic: auto-reverse or auto-retry failed activations; show order status and receipt in the app; give support a self-serve claim flow

pay_autopay.user_need: Set up auto-pay / recurring card payments
pay_autopay.product_change: Fix auto-pay enrolment ('Invalid Account Number'); add autopay status and next-charge date in the app

ux_slow.user_need: Faster screens and fewer steps to pay
ux_slow.product_change: Cut steps in the bill-pay flow; measure screen load times and remove retries on payment

feat_request.user_need: More plan detail, postpaid plans in the app, home Wi-Fi settings, WhatsApp bundles
feat_request.product_change: Backlog candidates: plan-detail view (GB left and shareable), postpaid plan management, home Wi-Fi/router settings in the app, social/WhatsApp bundles. Validate demand before building

acct_usage.user_need: See data, minutes and plan usage, not just the amount due
acct_usage.product_change: Add a usage dashboard (data/minutes left, GB shareable, expiry) on the home screen

conn_update.product_change: Add release regression tests on payment flows; staged rollouts with crash/error gates

ux_ads.product_change: Add notification preferences and frequency caps for promo pushes/SMS

bug_compat.user_need: Install on Huawei devices without Google Play

acct_lines.user_need: Link or unlink older accounts and lines
acct_lines.product_change: Fix account-linking errors; add a manage-lines screen

ux_confusing.product_change: Surface account details (plan, usage, due date) on the home screen

feat_share_balance.user_need: Send balance / share data to another line
feat_share_balance.product_change: Add balance transfer and data sharing with clear limits

svc_network.user_need: Reliable signal and internet, especially during outages
svc_network.product_change: Non-app: route to network operations. In-app: outage status and ETA by area, and proactive outage notifications

svc_pricing.user_need: Advance notice and an explanation of price or bill increases
svc_pricing.product_change: Non-app: commercial/pricing team. In-app: notify price changes ahead of time with bill breakdowns and plan-comparison options

svc_support.product_change: Non-app: customer care. In-app: case tracking with status, and chat handoff that keeps context (no call → chat → branch runaround)
